kcc_query_text_example: General category medium sugarcane grower with 6.5 acres canal command land in Maddur taluk, Mandya; facing intermittent rotational canal supply from Visvesvaraya canal; applying for drip irrigation subsidy for 2.50 hectares under PMKSY-PDMC; seeking quotation requirements and water source verification protocol.

landholding_details.physical_area_consistency: PASS: Requested 2.50 ha <= qualifying parcel 6.5 ac (2.6305 ha)

water_and_irrigation.grid_connection_evidence: Canal gravity flow with farm intermediate sump/pump set

statutory_flags.tenure_documentation: RTC registered pre-February 2019 in Maddur taluk

attribute_provenance.empirical_baseline: DES Karnataka & Mandya Irrigation Department: Cauvery basin canal command sugarcane cultivation in Maddur/Mandya taluks, transitioning to micro-irrigation to conserve canal water during low reservoir storage periods.
attribute_provenance.farmer_query_inspiration: KCC Karnataka PMKSY query logs: Medium farmers in canal commands inquiring about drip installation subsidies on holdings above 5.0 acres.
attribute_provenance.statutory_policy_test: Physical Area Cap & Medium Holding Gating: Evaluates PMKSY-PDMC on 6.5-acre holding; requested subsidized area of 2.50 ha strictly satisfies physical parcel capacity (2.50 ha <= 6.5 ac = 2.6305 ha) and statutory ceiling (2.50 ha <= 5.00 ha); qualifies for PMKSY-PDMC; PMFBY crop insurance subject to seasonal Kharif 2026 Insurance Unit notification verification; Krishi Bhagya disqualified due to irrigated canal status; Ganga Kalyana disqualified due to General Merit category and irrigated land type.

intended_test_purpose: Validate PMKSY-PDMC drip irrigation eligibility in canal command under 2.50 ha area cap; enforce dryland gating for Krishi Bhagya and affirmative welfare exclusions for Ganga Kalyana.
unresolved_dependencies: Verification of GoK Kharif 2026 PMFBY Insurance Unit (Gram Panchayat/Hobli level) notification for Sugarcane in Mandya district
